title: Opinion: Opinion | How Pakistan's Anti-India Obsession Turned Into A $40 Billion Blunder
summary_full: The country incurred an estimated $40 billion in losses due to trade with India being suspended in 2019, with businesses facing higher sourcing and logistics costs after being forced to import goods from distant markets.
